description: Source file implementing batched linear algebra routines for CUDA, including functions for QR factorization, LU decomposition, triangular solves, and least squares, specifically utilizing cuBLAS and cuSOLVER APIs. It supports split implementation for ROCm build targets.

methods.name: to_cublas
methods.description: Converts TransposeType enum to corresponding cuBLAS operation enum.

methods.name: get_device_pointers
methods.description: Creates a device array of pointers to individual matrices within a batched tensor.

methods.name: geqrf_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched QR factorization using cuBLAS.

methods.name: lu_factor_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched LU decomposition using cuBLAS.

methods.name: lu_solve_batched_cublas
methods.description: Solves batched linear systems using LU factors with cuBLAS.

methods.name: triangular_solve_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched triangular solve with cuBLAS, with workaround for CUDA < 12.1.

methods.name: gels_batched_cublas
methods.description: Performs batched least squares solve using cuBLAS.
